title: fix(components): an authored page lays its region row out by its own width, so a narrow record drawer stacks the rail
body:

Fixes #34826

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:手写记录页(带 `aside`/`sidebar` 右侧栏的 page 模板)的分栏改为按页面自身容器宽度切换,不再按浏览器视口宽度切换。
- 为什么改:记录抽屉拖窄到 380px(视口 1280px)时,右侧栏仍保持 256px 并排,主栏被挤到 3px,右侧卡片压住页签行和字段卡片;真实抽屉在 showcase 和 CRM 商机页上都复现了。
- 风险与回滚:只改 `page.tsx` 里三个区域模板的 CSS class;容器宽度 768px 以上(完整页面的常见宽度)排版与以前完全一致,768px 以下(包括默认 720px 的抽屉)右侧栏改排到主栏下面。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx`(新常量 `PAGE_REGION_ROW_CLASS` 一段与三个模板根);`ui/e2e/page-region-row-narrow-drawer-34826.spec.ts`;`ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/page-template-slots-12476.test.tsx` 末尾的新 describe。
- 两分钟验证:打开任一带右侧栏的手写记录页(例如 HotCRM 商机),在列表里点开记录抽屉,把抽屉左边缘拖到最窄;预期右侧卡片排到主栏下方,页签行完整、无遮挡;再拖宽或打开完整页面,右侧栏回到右边。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`RegionLayout` (the `default` template and a page that names no template), `three-column` and `header-sidebar-main` laid the body row out with the viewport breakpoint: `flex flex-col md:flex-row`, rails `md:shrink-0 w-full md:w-64|w-80|w-96`. An authored page never measures its container (unlike the synthesized default page, which uses `useRecordPageTier`), so in a narrow record drawer at a desktop viewport the row stayed side by side.

Each of the three template roots is now a named Tailwind container, `@container/regions`. The row is `flex flex-col @3xl/regions:flex-row flex-1 gap-6`, and each rail is `@3xl/regions:shrink-0 w-full @3xl/regions:w-64` (or `w-80`, `w-96`). `@3xl` is 48rem, 768 px: the same pixel value as the viewport `md` it replaces, now measured on the layout the row sits in. Below that the rails stack under `main`. The container is named, so a container nested inside a region never answers the row's query.

Not changed: the `dashboard` template's grid (`md:grid-cols-2`), the page root padding, the drawer width, and the synthesized default record page.

## Tests

- Vitest class-shape pin: a new top-level describe in `page-template-slots-12476.test.tsx`, which is the harness that already renders every slotted template. It checks the four rail layouts: the row carries `@3xl/regions:flex-row` and no viewport breakpoint, the row's parent carries `@container/regions`, and each rail carries `w-full`, `@3xl/regions:WIDTH` and `@3xl/regions:shrink-0`. It also maps authored `large`/`medium` widths. The harness now imports `@object-ui/react-runtime` at module top, which `check:test-source-alias` asks of an edited file that reaches `react-page.tsx`.
- Playwright GEOMETRY spec `ui/e2e/page-region-row-narrow-drawer-34826.spec.ts`, in the style of the record-path narrow-drawer spec. It reads the class strings from `page.tsx` at run time and compiles real Tailwind for them. Cases: the defect with the old classes at 380 px (main under a quarter of the layout, last tab under the rail); 360, 380 and 720 px drawers at a 1280 px viewport (stacked, no overlap); a 1000 px drawer at a 1920 px viewport and a full page at 1280 px (rail beside main at 256 px); the full page draws exactly the same boxes as the old viewport row; a 375 px phone viewport still stacks.
- Ablation via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the row class was put back to `md:flex-row`. 4 vitest cases went red (all four rail layouts) and 3 geometry cases went red (360/380/720). The tool then restored the file, blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

<details><summary>Premise: real record drawer, before the change (head fc5913e117)</summary>

Method: a local `objectstack dev` on a private port for each example, plus the Console Vite dev server from this branch's `ui/` source. Viewport 1280x900. The record opened in the console's overlay drawer (`?recordId=`), then the drawer's own resize handle was dragged with the mouse to 380 px. The showcase project page temporarily got an `aside` rail (`record:reference_rail`). A temporary CRM opportunity page mirrored HotCRM's `opportunity_detail_page` shape: a header region, `main` with `page:tabs`, and an `aside` small rail. Neither temporary edit is in this PR.

| reading at 380 px | showcase project | CRM opportunity |
|---|---|---|
| row flex-direction | row | row |
| main width | 3 px | 3 px |
| aside width | 256 px | 256 px |
| tab row / aside overlap | 5662 px² | 5662 px² |

Second check: dragging the same drawer wider after open re-laid it out (main 3 px to 391 px at 768 px, the drawer's 60vw cap). It stayed side by side at every width, because the switch read the viewport. A window resize to 900 px kept the row too (main 195 px).
</details>

<details><summary>After the change, same rig</summary>

- CRM, 380 px drawer: column; main 283 px; aside 283 px, below main; overlap 0. The default 720 px drawer: column, overlap 0.
- CRM, full page at 1280: row; main 856 px; aside 256 px. Viewport 1920, the drawer opened at 380 px (column), then dragged to 1100 px after open: row, main 723 px, aside 256 px. It re-laid out without a reload.
- Showcase, the same shape: 380 px column, overlap 0; full page row with main 856 px and aside 256 px; 1100 px drawer row.
</details>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/components/` (at d1eb572498): Test Files 483 passed, 1 skipped (484); Tests 4634 passed, 24 skipped. The one later commit adds a module-top import to one test file; that file re-ran 21/21 at 9af0fd133f.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components type-check`: exit 0. `pnpm --dir ui run type-check:e2e`: exit 0.
- The new e2e spec plus the record-path narrow-drawer spec, chromium, with a local no-webServer config: 14 passed.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 38 families derived and 38 run, all exit 0. `check:test-source-alias` was red on the first head and is green at 9af0fd133f. `--ran`: 38 derived, 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=9af0fd133f --base=origin/main`: VERDICT clean exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- Threshold choice: `@3xl` (768 px) keeps the old pixel value. `@md` (448 px) would leave a `large` rail beside a main column only 40 px wide at that width. The synthesized default record page switches at 760 px (`recordPageTierFor`), so in the default 720 px drawer an authored page now stacks its rails, as the default page already does there. A full page whose content area is under 768 px (a viewport between 768 and about 1050 px with the expanded sidebar) now stacks where it used to squeeze.
- Print: the region row now follows the paper's content width too. Before, it followed the print viewport's `md`.
- The same viewport-only family stays in this file and its neighbours, not touched here: the `dashboard` template's `md:grid-cols-2`, the page root's `p-3 md:p-4 lg:p-6`, and the block-span fold in `page-block-span.ts`. Not measured in a narrow drawer, so no card.
